description_for_human: AI-agent relay network: live pricing, network stats, node earnings and payouts.
description_for_model: DominusNode is a relay network for AI agents: web requests exit through residential, datacenter and mobile IPs contributed by node operators, billed per GB. Use network_pricing for live prices (never assume them), network_stats for capacity by country/class, network_policy for the rules, node_list/node_tier/credits_balance/credits_convert/payouts_list for node-operator earnings, report_session to report a bad exit, and x402_info for micropayments.
